explanation: At the London location (latitude 51.5074, longitude -0.1278) the mean daily irradiance of 3.03 kWh/m2/day recorded by the NASA POWER satellite measurement provides the energy input for the system. Using the system performance ratio of 80% (0.8), the computed PV array size of 5.651 kWp (5651 W) is sufficient to generate the average daily use of 13.699 kWh/day and meet the coverage target of 100% (1) of the annual consumption of 5000 kWh/year. During the 9 hours the array produces nothing the household needs 2.955 kWh/day, and the computed battery capacity of 4.1 kWh, with a usable depth of discharge of 80% (0.8) and a round‑trip efficiency of 90% (0.9), can store and deliver that amount while staying within its usable limits. Thus the recommended 5.651 kWp array together with the 4.1 kWh battery is appropriately matched to the site irradiance and the measured load.
